text:
Olivia: Morning — EU reseller PO signatory flow is stuck; marketplace portal rejects their signed PO with `billing_entity_mismatch`. Partner insists they used their legal billing name. Anyone seen this?

Luca: Can you paste the portal rejection error? Also which reseller?

Olivia: Reseller = "RetailEdge EU GmbH". Portal returns: "error: billing_entity_mismatch (expected 'RetailEdge GmbH', got 'RetailEdge EU GmbH')". Partner sent signed PO via email.

Maya: FYI finance: we need exact entity match to ledger alias. If name differs we can't accept until vendor alias added. Partner's VAT looks valid though. :thinking: 

partner_ops_bot: marketplace-webhook: 422 Unprocessable Entity — invalid_billing_entity. payload: `{\"vendor_id\":\"rv-8921\",\"billing_name\":\"RetailEdge EU GmbH\",\"vat\":\"DE123456789\"}` (log id: wb-98431)

Ivan: Legal: partner redlined section 9 (indemnity). They added "cap to 1M EUR" which is okay but they removed "third-party IP" carveout. We need to push back unless finance needs to accept with exceptions.

Priya: We're blocked on two tracks: (1) platform validation/alias, (2) legal redline. Which is blocking PO acceptance?

Maya: Platform validation — finance can't ingest PO until alias sync. Legal redline can be escalated in parallel; we can accept if legal signs off on risk.

Tessa: Platform eng — I can add a temporary mapping for vendor_id rv-8921 -> ledger alias "REU-GMBH" and bypass strict name match for this merchant. Need SRE approval for manual write. I can run patch: 
```
POST /admin/vendor_aliases
{ "vendor_id":"rv-8921", "alias":"REU-GMBH" }
```

Priya: @Tessa please do, also can we accept PO via Docusign instead of portal? Partner prefers Docusign flow.

Tessa: We can accept Docusign but need finance confirm ingestion path. I'll also whitelist their vendor_id for the next 24h.

Maya: Confirmed. Finance will ingest Docusign PDF once vendor alias exists. Please send to procurement inbox procurement@redwood.com. :white_check_mark: 

Ivan: On legal, I'll propose compromise language to restore "third-party IP" carveout and leave cap at 1M. Sending suggested redline now.

Olivia: Partner accepted Docusign, sent signed PO to procurement@redwood.com. They also accepted the revised indemnity text. :relieved: 

partner_ops_bot: webhook: alias created for rv-8921 -> REU-GMBH (actor: tessa, time: 1735550300)

Maya: Ingested PO from procurement inbox, mapped to alias, cleared for processing. We'll issue invoice and complete onboarding. Thanks team. :tada: 

Priya: Great — closing the escalation. Notes: need to add vendor-alias UI in marketplace portal to avoid manual patches. @tessa can you open a ticket?

Tessa: Opening ticket: MKT-4123 "vendor alias UI + relaxed EU name normalization". Assigning to eng-platform. ETA: 2 sprints.

Olivia: Thanks everyone. Marking resolved.
